description: Explicit deck-name → family override map for Meta Call rollups. _aggregateFieldByFamily groups variants by extractMainPokemon (first-word heuristic). That works for cleanly-named families like Dragapult (every Dragapult build starts with the word 'Dragapult'), but mis-groups others — 'Ogerpon Meganium', 'Ogerpon Meganium Arboliva', 'Ogerpon Meganium Hydrapple', AND 'Ogerpon Noivern' all extract to the single 'Ogerpon' bucket even though Noivern is a different archetype. This file overrides the heuristic per deck-name: anything not listed here falls back to extractMainPokemon. Add entries when Labs introduces a new variant naming convention that the heuristic gets wrong. `key` becomes the family identifier (variants sharing a key get rolled up together); `display` is what the UI renders for the family label.
